plain: Lou Elizondo, a guest on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, passes on the story of James McDonald, a well-known physicist who he thinks was at Arizona State. Elizondo believes McDonald saw a UFO at the Savannah River site, though he isn't sure. Michels tells it with more certainty: he says McDonald saw a UFO at the Savannah River nuclear facility in South Carolina and was then publicly mocked for it. They tell it to show that a serious scientist saw something over a nuclear site and was pushed to the margins for saying so.
